text.content:
The ambulance you get when you didn't pay Trauma Team.

Kind: Cut-rate emergency medical service, city contracted
Purpose: Handling the cases Trauma Team won't, which is most of them

REO Meatwagon runs old ground ambulances held together with tape. Half its patients don't reach the hospital alive, some don't reach it at all, and there are rumors of links to scavs. Some of its paramedics are good; don't count on getting one of them.

Gig hooks

  • A Meatwagon paramedic thinks their partner is selling patients.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.28
